## Findings
- [ ] **[WARN][Docs] `--overwrite` flag and MCP `output_root` warning undocumented in README**
  - **Status quo:** README CLI/config sections do not mention the new `render --overwrite` guard (#100) or the MCP `output_root` startup warning (#99); no `docs/` file covers them either.
  - **Likely cause:** #101 documented the math/PDF-UA capability (Aug-3 BLOCK) but not the two smaller features merged just before it; README convention lists commands, not flags.
  - **Proposed solution:** Optional one-line additions (`render --overwrite` in the CLI block, `[mcp] output_root` in Configuration) in the release commit, or plan via review next cycle.
  - **Handoff:** `/02-gh-plan --from-review` (next cycle) or fold into the release commit — not a release blocker.

- [ ] **[WARN][Milestone] Open milestone `v0.3.1` title stale vs target `v0.4.0`**
  - **Status quo:** Milestone #4 `v0.3.1` is open with 3 closed issues (85, 86, 87) and 0 open; all three shipped in this unreleased diff. Issue #93 (`release: cut v0.4.0`) is open and is this release's tracking issue.
  - **Likely cause:** Milestone was titled before the two `feat` PRs (#99, #100) raised the planned release from patch to minor.
  - **Proposed solution:** `07-gh-release` renames milestone `v0.3.1` → `v0.4.0` at release (step 13) and closes it; #93 closes with the release.
  - **Handoff:** handled by `/07-gh-release` — no prerelease action needed.
